source_document_header: official NBA gamebook PDFs of 2026-11-17 (statsdmz.nba.com/pdfs/20261117/) and the day scoreboard https://www.nba.com/games?date=2026-11-17
extraction_tool: fetch_page (gamebook PDF text extraction per game) + fetch_page on the day's games page for the independent finals cross-check
row_format_note: away_q/home_q hold the four printed quarters; away_ot/home_ot hold printed overtime periods only (empty arrays when the game printed none); arena and city are blank when not read from an official document

verification.quarter_sum_rule: a team line settles only when its printed period scores (four quarters, plus any printed overtime periods) add to the printed final

finals_cross_check.rule: the games page prints the final of every game of the date; a game whose two official documents disagree would produce no row

verification.irregularity: the gamebook's home (Toronto) period cells split across extraction chunks; the official game page LINESCORES (29/21/33/19/102) completes the row and matches the book's printed Q1/Q2 and final - recorded here

extraction_notes: One row per game of 2026-11-17: all 5 games of the date, transcribed from the official gamebook PDF of each game (SCORE BY PERIOD block) and cross-checked against the official games page for the date (https://www.nba.com/games?date=2026-11-17).
Every printed final agrees between the two official documents (gamebook and games page).
one game of this date went to overtime (CHA@LAL): the OT column carries the printed OT period score and the period sum includes it
The arena and city columns are left blank because the day scoreboard does not print venues and this cycle did not fetch a venue document for these games; the cells are never guessed.

the NYK@TOR gamebook's home (Toronto) period cells split across the extraction chunks; the official game page LINESCORES for the same game prints 29/21/33/19/102, matching the gamebook's printed Q1 and Q2 and its printed final - the completed row is that reading.
